linkPattern.classification: External consumer website-translation link convention, not a documented stable API contract

parameterMeaning.sl: auto requests original-language detection; it is not an allowed target language.
parameterMeaning.tl: An explicitly selected target code from the bounded validated UI allowlist.
parameterMeaning.u: The one existing approved public HTTPS original URL, encoded as a single query value.

linkPattern.constructWith: URL plus URLSearchParams; never concatenate an unescaped original URL or accept a caller-selected translation host/path.
linkPattern.communityEvidenceNotUsedAsFormalSpecific: Search surfaced public support-community examples of sl/tl and /translate?u, including failures. Community answers are not an official supported API guarantee and were not used to certify the pattern.
linkPattern.fallback: Keep the existing original link available. If Google rejects a URL/region/site or changes the link shape, let the user open the original or use the official website-translation screen; do not display an app success state or fabricate a translated title/body.

languageScope: These eight confirmed options are a bounded initial choice set, not all Google languages. Do not extrapolate Cloud-only codes or accept arbitrary tl values. Additional targets need the same public official/UI compatibility check.

privacyAndInteractionContract.trigger: Only an explicit native user click/keyboard activation of the translation link.
privacyAndInteractionContract.notAppFetched: The app does not fetch or store the translated page, original body, external proxy result or translated title.
privacyAndInteractionContract.noBackgroundRequest: No app fetch, prefetch, preload, preconnect, iframe, hidden translation request or translation call when choosing the language or rendering the list.
privacyAndInteractionContract.externalProcessingDisclosure: 클릭하면 공개 원문 URL과 선택 언어가 Google 번역으로 전달됩니다. Google이 해당 원문을 가져와 번역할 수 있습니다. 개인 자료·관심·반응은 보내지 않습니다.
privacyAndInteractionContract.browserMetadataCaveat: Public-URL-only describes the app payload. Normal external navigation also exposes ordinary network/browser information and may use the user's Google cookies/session; noreferrer does not make Google navigation anonymous.
privacyAndInteractionContract.validation: Use the current public-feed/snapshot sourceId plus approved HTTPS host policy and canonical URL. Reject unsupported target codes, invalid/unapproved URLs, credentials, non-HTTPS schemes and private-library arbitrary input. Do not turn an arbitrary pasted URL into a public approved original.
privacyAndInteractionContract.retainedBehaviour: Translation navigation does not mark read/like/bookmark, import material, change original URL/version/rights, alter recommendation scoring, or claim full-text acquisition. The original link and exact same-list return remain available.

limitations: The exact consumer deep-link query is not certified as a stable API by the checked primary help page.
The official help explicitly limits availability by region and device; successful anonymous HTML retrieval does not guarantee every translation is login-free or avoids consent/captcha.
Publisher access controls, JavaScript pages, paywalls, CAPTCHA, network failures and external service changes may prevent translation. No bypass is proposed.
Machine translation can mistranslate research claims or terminology. It is not the publisher's verified original, and availability does not establish translation quality.
No real Google login, Apple browser/native tab return, popup/consent behaviour, actual translation, reading usefulness or OS-file workflow was verified.

evidence.firstUIGet: Stopped at the initial2MiB read bound; the later fixed blank UI GET succeeded under an explicit8MiB bound. No article URL was sent in either request.
evidence.publicationDates: Help/UI pages had no identified editorial date. CheckedAt is distinct from the Cloud page's displayed2026-10-13 update date.
